title: Mixed Event — Run! Sports Festival! Committee Rush — Episode5 SEKAI Cheerleader!

meta.Event Outline: Saki invites Haruka to join the Sports Festival Planning Committee. Together with fellow committee member Emu, they strive to make the Sports Festival a fun and joyful event, but how will it turn out?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We pledge to compete fairly, uphold the values of sportsmanship and make today's Sports Festival a smile and fun-filled event for everyone!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Let the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy Sports Festival begin!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I hope her pledge comes true and everyone has a good time.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Otori, you did a great job with the pledge. It was very you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go have a lot of fun today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The ball toss is next.
Are the baskets ready?

rows.Speaker: 1st Year Committee Member A
rows.Line: Yeah. We're going to set them up as soon as everyone clears the field.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
<Second years, please exit the field.
Next, we have the first-year ball toss event.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sounds like they're finished.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Look how colorful these balls are! They're so cute! This one even has a little drawing of a hamster!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This one has a bunny. The ones from practice were just the normal ones, so did they do this just for the event? This must have been a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're too cute! I can't throw them...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we won't win if you don't...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, did you see the second years' bamboo pole tug-of-war?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, I did! Wasn't Momoi amazing?! She jumped right into the thick of it and stole like five poles!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hinomori did really well too! She never ran but gave off some kind of aura that made everyone avoid taking anything from her so she wouldn't get hurt...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
It looks like everyone's enjoying themselves♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Time for me to get ready for the three-legged race...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? That sounded like Miku...
Did that come from my phone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehehe! I'm here to cheer you on, just like I promised!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
Your pom-poms look so cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right?! I worked really hard to make them after you left yesterday!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <KAITO even helped me and told me to go have fun today☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That was nice of him!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The three-legged race is soon.
Will you cheer for me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but it's not going to be easy for you to see me from here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait! I know a special spot that has the best view of the whole campus! Wanna try there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's the best seat in the house!
This is the tallest tree in the whole school♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right?! It's got a perfect view of where we'll be entering the field. Oh, and you won't get lonely here since the other cheer squads are close by too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, I should get going, Miku.
I'll come back once I'm finished!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Alright! Time to get my cheer on!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Let's go, Emu! You can do it!>

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Next up is the mixed three-legged race.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Miku's cheering me on, so I've gotta do my best!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm ready to win!
Let's do this, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. If we're going to race, we might as well win.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: And they're off! This year, each pair has students from different grades!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: And it looks like one of the second/third-year pairs has taken the lead!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori, is this a good pace?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! But I can still go a little faster!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Then let's try to get out in front?

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
And here comes the Otori/Asahina pair!
One of the first/second year pairs!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have a chance to take the lead. Think you can do it?

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Look at that speed! The Otori/Asahina pair is overtaking one group after another.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's keep up this pace all the way!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line:
And we have a winner!
Otori and Asahina claim first place!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo! We did it!
I hope Miku saw that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good work, Otori. I couldn't have won this without you, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line:
Mafuyu! That was so cool!
Our peerless athletic superstar!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I knew it! I knew it wasn't real!!)
